defaults.label: The Abyssal Throne
defaults.name: The Abyssal Throne
defaults.description: The epicenter of all corruption. A monstrous throne of obsidian and bone rises from the fractured earth, pulsing with dark energy that warps reality itself. Only the mightiest war-parties dare challenge what sits upon it.

coordinates.name: The Abyssal Throne
coordinates.description: At the exact center of the world stands a monolithic throne carved from a single shard of void-crystal. It pulses with an energy that warps time and space. Here the Dark Sovereign awaits, eternal and patient, for challengers foolish enough to claim dominion over the abyss.
coordinates.flavorText: All paths lead here. None lead back.
coordinates.regionLoreSnippet: The throne was not built — it grew, feeding on the corruption that seeped from the world's fractured core.
